name: Briggs
bio: Has shouted himself hoarse at every drill since basic. His whisper still rattles windows.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A stocky, moustached soldier in an olive parka with a black utility belt.
